subject: Great Fairy
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem makes the Great Fairy appear to teach the Super Spin Attack and grant a Magic Meter.

evidence.quote:
Run forward to the fountain, and stand on the Triforce emblem.  Play Zelda's
Lullaby to make the Dominatrix er, uh... Great Fairy appear.  She will teach
you the Super Spin Attack, which adds extra damage and range to your basic Spin
Attack.  She'll also grant you a Magic Meter.

subject: Death Mountain Trail
text: A cave entrance to the right of Kaepora Gaebora leads into Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: Enter the cave face to the right of KG.

subject: Death Mountain Crater
text: A Gold Skulltula is found inside the crates to the left immediately upon entering Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote:
For the moment, smash both of the crates to your left as
soon as you enter to find a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token, then
go back out to the Trail.

subject: Kaepora Gaebora
text: Speaking with Kaepora Gaebora gives Link a flight down to Kakariko Village, dropping him onto Impa's House.

evidence.quote:
Speak with Kaepora Gaebora, who will give you a lift down the mountain to
Kakariko Village.

Kaepora Gaebora not only brought you back to Kakariko Village... he even
dropped you on top of Impa's House!

subject: Impa's House
text: Dropping down from the roof of Impa's House onto the balcony above the Cucco Pasture leads to a Piece of Heart inside.

evidence.quote:
If you didn't get the Piece
of Heart from inside of Impa's House, then get it now by dropping down from the
roof onto the balcony above the Cucco Pasture.

subject: Sun's Song
text: Playing the Sun's Song warps Link back to the top of Impa's House roof if the balcony drop is missed.

evidence.quote:
If you miss it, then play the
Sun's Song and you'll warp back to the top of the roof.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: A decursed man on the left side of the House of Skulltula rewards Link with the Stone of Agony.

evidence.quote:
Go to the left side of the room, where a recently-decursed man will give you
the Stone of Agony.

subject: Hyrule Castle
text: Playing the Sun's Song at nighttime opens the gates of Hyrule Castle.

evidence.quote:
If it is nighttime,
play the Sun's Song to open the gates.

subject: Hyrule Castle Garden
text: Climbing ivy above the gate and bombing a boulder at the dead end reveals a crawl tunnel to a Great Fairy's Fountain.

evidence.quote:
Climb the ivy on the right to the cliff above the gate.  Run over to the marble
gate, and drop down on the other side.  Run over to the dead end (it's marked
with a sign which reads "Dead End").  Bomb the boulder to reveal a small
tunnel.  Crawl through the tunnel to find another Great Fairy's Fountain.

subject: Great Fairy
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the Hyrule Castle Great Fairy's Fountain grants Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Run to the Fountain, and stand on the Triforce Emblem.  Play Zelda's Lullaby on
the Ocarina to make another Dominatrix appear.  She'll give you Din's Fire, an
area of effect spell which burns all enemies in the room (and can also light
large numbers of braziers at the same time).

subject: Hyrule Castle Garden
text: Getting spotted by a guard in the Hyrule Castle Garden causes Link to be thrown back out to the gate.

evidence.quote:
Allow one of the guards to spot you, and you will be thrown back out to the
gate.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Playing a game at the Bombchu Bowling Alley costs 30 rupees.

evidence.quote: Pay the clerk 30 rupees to play the game.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: The Bombchu Bowling Alley minigame offers a Piece of Heart, Bomb Bag upgrade, and Bombchus as winnable prizes.

evidence.quote:
This minigame has no less then three new things to win (Piece of Heart, Bomb
Bag and Bombchus), and isn't cheap to play.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Completing all three goals in Bombchu Bowling can award a Bomb Bag holding up to 40 bombs.

evidence.quote:
New Equipment: Bomb Bag x40...Completing all
three goals successfully will win you whatever prize the clerk showed you at
the start.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Completing all three rounds of Bombchu Bowling can reward Link with Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
New Item: Bombchus...Completing all
three goals successfully will win you whatever prize the clerk showed you at
the start.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: In Bombchu Bowling, send a Bombchu straight from the middle for central targets, but adjust position to the left or right when the round 2 target appears on the right.

evidence.quote:
When you're playing Bombchu Bowling, always position yourself in the center of
the field.  The one exception is when the target appears on the right in the
second round; you have to minorly adjust your position to the left or right,  otherwise it's impossible to angle yourself properly for the Bombchu to enter
the target.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: Link must pay 20 rupees for the Skull Mask before borrowing the Spooky Mask from the Happy Mask Shop.

evidence.quote: Pay the 20 rupees for the Skull Mask, then borrow the Spooky Mask.

subject: Dampe's Fanboy
text: Speaking to the boy wandering Kakariko Graveyard during daytime while wearing the Spooky Mask prompts him to buy it for 30 rupees.

evidence.quote:
Speak with Dampe's
Fanboy (the little kid who walks around the graves during the day) while
wearing the Spooky Mask, and he'll buy it from you for 30 rupees.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: Paying 30 rupees for the Spooky Mask allows Link to borrow the Bunny Hood from the Happy Mask Shop.

evidence.quote: Pay the 30 rupees for the Spooky Mask, then borrow the Bunny Hood.
